pairs: A wise man will seek the wisdom of all the ancients,
and he will be occupied in the prophets.
He will preserve the words of renowned men,
et in versutias parabolarum simul introibit.
and he will enter with them into the subtleties of parables.
He will search for the hidden meanings of proverbs,
and he will become familiar with the mysteries of parables.
He will minister in the midst of great men,
and he will appear in the sight of the foremost leader.
He will pass through the land of foreign nations.
bona enim et mala in hominibus tentabit.
For he will test good and evil among men.
Cor suum tradet ad vigilandum diluculo ad Dominum,
he will offer his heart with watchfulness to the Lord who made him,
and he will pray in the sight of the Most High.
He will open his mouth in prayer,
and he will make supplication for his offenses.
For if the great Lord is willing,
he will fill him with the Spirit of understanding.
et ipse tamquam imbres mittet eloquia sapientiæ suæ,
And he will send forth the eloquence of his wisdom like rain showers,
and in his prayer, he will confess to the Lord.
And he will direct his counsel
and he will meditate on his mysteries.
Ipse palam faciet disciplinam doctrinæ suæ,
He will make the discipline of his doctrine clear,
et in lege testamenti Domini gloriabitur.
and he will glory in the law of the covenant of the Lord.
Many persons will together praise his wisdom,
et usque in sæculum non delebitur.
and it will never be abolished, for all ages.
The memory of him will not fade away,
et nomen ejus requiretur a generatione in generationem.
and his name will be sought from generation to generation.
The peoples will declare his wisdom,
and the Church will announce his praise.
he leaves behind a name greater than a thousand,
it will be to his benefit.
I will meditate further, so that I may explain.
For I have been filled with a passion.
et quasi rosa plantata super rivos aquarum fructificate.
You shall bear fruit, like roses planted beside streams of waters.
You shall have a sweet fragrance, like the cedars of Lebanon.
Blossom with flowers, like the lily,
et benedicite Dominum in operibus suis.
and bless the Lord in his works.
et confitemini illi in voce labiorum vestrorum, et in canticis labiorum, et citharis:
and confess to him with the voice of your lips and with the canticles of your mouth and with stringed instruments.
And in so praising him, you will confess:
All the works of the Lord are very good.
In verbo ejus stetit aqua sicut congeries:
At his word, the waters stood still, as if piled together.
et in sermone oris illius sicut exceptoria aquarum:
And at the words of his mouth, the waters were contained, as if in basins of water.
quoniam in præcepto ipsius placor fit,
For it is made pleasing by his precept,
et non est minoratio in salute ipsius.
and there is no decrease in his salvation.
The works of all flesh are in his sight,
et non est quidquam absconditum ab oculis ejus.
and there is nothing hidden from his eyes.
A sæculo usque in sæculum respicit,
His gaze is from eternity to eternity,
et nihil est mirabile in conspectu ejus.
and nothing is a wonder in his sight.
omnia enim in tempore suo quærentur.
For all things will be sought in their time.
His blessing has overflowed like a river.
In the same way that a flood inundates the dry land,
sic ira ipsius gentes quæ non exquisierunt eum hæreditabit.
so also will his wrath inherit the peoples that have not sought him.
In the same way that he turned the waters into dry land,
et viæ illius viis illorum directæ sunt,
and just as his ways have been directed for their journey,
sic peccatoribus offensiones in ira ejus.
so also will sinners stumble before his wrath.
Bona bonis creata sunt ab initio:
From the beginning, good things were created for those who are good,
and similarly, good and evil things are for those who are wicked.
The principal things necessary for the life of men are:
All these things will be used for good by those who are holy,
sic et impiis et peccatoribus in mala convertentur.
but they will be turned to evil use by the impious and by sinners.
Sunt spiritus qui ad vindictam creati sunt,
There are spirits that have been created for vengeance,
et in furore suo confirmaverunt tormenta sua.
and they strengthen their torments by their fury.
In the time of the consummation, they will pour forth their strength.
et furorem ejus qui fecit illos placabunt.
And they will appease the fury of the One who made them.
omnia hæc ad vindictam creata sunt:
all these were created for vengeance.
et rhomphæa vindicans in exterminium impios.
all these take vengeance upon the impious, unto utter destruction.
At his command, they will feast.
et super terram in necessitatem præparabuntur,
And they will be prepared upon the earth until they are needed.
et in temporibus suis non præterient verbum.
And in their time, they will not ignore his word.
For this reason, from the beginning, I was strengthened,
and I have put these things in writing.
All the works of the Lord are good,
et omne opus hora sua subministrabit.
and he will provide for each work in its own hour.
omnia enim in tempore suo comprobabuntur.
For all things will be tested in their time.
Et nunc in omni corde et ore collaudate,
And now, with the whole heart and mouth, give praise to him,
and bless the name of the Lord.
